# Helion Research

> Helion Research is a market research agency specialised in Sales Channel Performance Intelligence: mystery shopping, retail auditing and exit interviews that show how brands perform at the point of sale, in 100+ countries.

Helion Research (legal name Helion Market Research BV) was founded in 2009 and is headquartered at Quellinstraat 6, 2018 Antwerpen, Belgium, with offices in Sofia (Bulgaria) and Johannesburg (South Africa). It covers 100+ countries with a Panel of 250.000+ evaluators. Clients work with one account manager as their single point of contact. Member of Febelmar and MSPA. CEO: Thomas Schimmel. MD Europe and Research Director: Dimitri De Geyndt. Contact: info@helionresearch.com, +32 3 609 50 01.

## Services

- [Mystery Shopping](https://www.helionresearch.com/mystery-shopping.html): Trained evaluators visit, call and e-mail your locations as real customers and measure every step against your own standards.
- [Retail Auditing](https://www.helionresearch.com/retail-auditing.html): Audits of merchandising, POS, prices and availability in store, backed by photos.
- [Exit Interviews](https://www.helionresearch.com/exit-interviews.html): Short interviews with real customers as they leave the store, plus web surveys, focus groups and AI-moderated interviews.

## Frequently asked questions

### What does Helion Research do?

Helion Research is a market research agency, founded in 2009 and headquartered in Antwerp, Belgium. It specialises in Sales Channel Performance Intelligence: mystery shopping, retail auditing and exit interviews that show how brands perform at the point of sale, what that costs and what to fix first.

### In which countries does Helion Research work?

Helion Research covers 100+ countries from offices in Antwerp, Sofia and Johannesburg, with a Panel of 250.000+ evaluators. One programme can cover all your markets.

### Why use one provider for all your markets?

With one provider, every market uses the same scenarios, the same scoring and the same quality process, so results can be compared. You sign one contract and work with one account manager as your single point of contact.

### What is the difference between mystery shopping, retail auditing and exit interviews?

Mystery shopping measures how staff sell and advise, through evaluators who act as real customers. Retail auditing checks what is present, visible and compliant in store, such as displays, prices and availability. Exit interviews ask real customers about their experience as they leave.

### How does Helion Research guarantee data quality?

Evaluators are recruited, trained and certified the same way in every location. Every report is checked before it counts: automated checks first, then a Helion Research editor.

### Which sectors does Helion Research work in?

Automotive dealers, luxury boutiques, retail stores, banking branches, fuel stations, on-trade venues, contact centres and e-commerce.

### How do I start a programme?

Tell us what you would like to measure and in which markets. Your account manager comes back with a proposal: the scenario, the locations and the timing, with your own standards as the yardstick.
